definition: caused by a virus that spreads
description: A crowded university lecture hall in winter with wooden benches and globe lamps. In the front row a young woman in a cream beanie and a green scarf coughs with her eyes screwed shut, then blows her nose into a tissue, crumpled tissues piled on the desk in front of her. A young man behind her pulls his jumper over his nose, a young woman on the right squirts hand sanitiser onto her hands, and a young woman behind leans so far away that she ends up lying across the bench.

en.question: What is the woman with tissues doing?

de.answer: Sie putzt sich die Nase mit einem Taschentuch.
de.question: Was macht die Frau mit den Taschentüchern?

es.answer: Se está sonando la nariz con un pañuelo.
phrases: tumbarse a lo ancho del banco

fr.answer: Elle se mouche dans un mouchoir.
